answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, and let that stake grow with reputation earned over a long voyage of completed work. A fresh identity starts at zero trust, like a willow sapling, while an established one is basalt-solid: it has sunk costs and a history peers can check. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught cheating. Scale becomes a bill, not a free trick.
